title: Copy the API URL and Instance ID

blocks.content: The SDK needs three values from Grafana Cloud. The first two, **API URL** and **Instance ID**, come from Agent Observability itself. Save both somewhere you can find them later, such as a notes file. Milestone 4 turns them into environment variables.
Open the setup screen, copy the two values, and save them for later.

blocks.hint: Don't see **Start setup**? Your stack already has data. Open **Configuration** in Agent Observability instead; it lists the same **API URL** and **Instance ID**.

blocks.content:
Under **Your credentials**, copy **API URL** and save it somewhere, such as a notes file.

This is the value for `AGENTO11Y_ENDPOINT`. You set that environment variable to this URL later. The SDK reads it when you create the client, and sends generation data to that address.
blocks.hint: If the panel is collapsed, click **Your credentials** to expand it.

blocks.content:
Copy **Instance ID** and save it in the same place.

It is the numeric Grafana Cloud stack ID, and the value for `AGENTO11Y_AUTH_TENANT_ID`. You set that environment variable to this ID later. The SDK uses it to say which stack the data belongs to.
You have saved **API URL** and **Instance ID** for later.
